lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ ਛੋਡਹਿ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kar haario anik bahu bhaatee chhodahi katahoo(n) naahee ||
lines.translation: Trying all sorts of things, I have grown weary, but still, they will not leave me alone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨਿ ਤਾਕੀ ਓਟਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ek baat sun taakee otaa saadhasa(n)g mit jaahee ||2||
lines.translation: But I have heard that they can be rooted out, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; and so I seek their Shelter. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਤੇ ਧੀਰਜੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa sa(n)t mile mohi tin te dheeraj paaiaa ||
lines.translation: In their Mercy, the Saints have met me, and from them, I have obtained satisfaction.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤੀ ਮੰਤੁ ਦੀਓ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tee ma(n)t deeo mohi nirabhau gur kaa sabad kamaaiaa ||3||
lines.translation: The Saints have given me the Mantra of the Fearless Lord, and now I practice the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਤਿ ਲਏ ਓਇ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਾਦੀ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeet lae oi mahaa bikhaadee sahaj suhelee baanee ||
lines.translation: I have now conquered those terrible evil-doers, and my speech is now sweet and sublime.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੨੫॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak man bhaiaa paragaasaa paaiaa pad nirabaanee ||4||4||125||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, the Divine Light has dawned within my mind; I have obtained the state of Nirvaanaa. ||4||4||125||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ohu abinaasee raaiaa ||
lines.translation: He is the Eternal King.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੈ ਬਸਤੇ ਇਹੁ ਡਰਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਤੇ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: nirabhau sa(n)g tumaarai basate ihu daran kahaa te aaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Fearless Lord abides with you. So where does this fear come from? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਹੋਹਿ ਅਫਾਰੋ ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ ਨਿਮਾਨੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: ek mahal too(n) hohi aphaaro ek mahal nimaano ||
lines.translation: In one person, You are arrogant and proud, and in another, You are meek and humble.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ ਗਰੀਬਾਨੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ek mahal too(n) aape aape ek mahal gareebaano ||1||
lines.translation: In one person, You are all by Yourself, and in another, You are poor. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਬਕਤਾ ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ ਖਲੁ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ek mahal too(n) pa(n)dit bakataa ek mahal khal hotaa ||
lines.translation: In one person, you are a Pandit, a religious scholar and a preacher, and in another, You are just a fool.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਗ੍ਰਾਹਜੁ ਏਕ ਮਹਲਿ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਲੇਤਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ek mahal too(n) sabh kichh graahaj ek mahal kachhoo na letaa ||2||
lines.translation: In one person, You grab hold of everything, and in another, You accept nothing. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਠ ਕੀ ਪੁਤਰੀ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਬਪੁਰੀ ਖਿਲਾਵਨਹਾਰੋ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaath kee putaree kahaa karai bapuree khilaavanahaaro jaanai ||
lines.translation: What can the poor wooden puppet do? The Master Puppeteer knows everything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਭੇਖੁ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਬਾਜੀਗਰੁ ਓਹੁ ਤੈਸੋ ਹੀ ਸਾਜੁ ਆਨੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jaisaa bhekh karaavai baajeegar ohu taiso hee saaj aanai ||3||
lines.translation: As the Puppeteer dresses the puppet, so is the role the puppet plays. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਕੋਠਰੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਭਾਤਿ ਕਰੀਆ ਆਪਿ ਹੋਆ ਰਖਵਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: anik kotharee bahut bhaat kareeaa aap hoaa rakhavaaraa ||
lines.translation: The Lord has created the various chambers of assorted descriptions, and He Himself protects them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਮਹਲਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਤੈਸੈ ਰਹਨਾ ਕਿਆ ਇਹੁ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jaise mahal raakhai taisai rahanaa kiaa ihu karai bichaaraa ||4||
lines.translation: As is that vessel in which the Lord places the soul, so does it dwell. What can this poor being do? ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਾਜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kichh keeaa soee jaanai jin ih sabh bidh saajee ||
lines.translation: The One who created the thing, understands it; He has fashioned all of this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਾਜੀ ॥੫॥੫॥੧੨੬॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak apara(n)par suaamee keemat apune kaajee ||5||5||126||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, the Lord and Master is Infinite; He alone understands the value of His Creation. ||5||5||126||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ₃ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee₃ mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਰੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕੇ ਰਸੂਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhod chhod re bikhiaa ke rasooaa ||
lines.translation: Give them up - give up the pleasures of corruption;

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਰੇ ਬਾਵਰ ਗਾਵਰ ਜਿਉ ਕਿਰਖੈ ਹਰਿਆਇਓ ਪਸੂਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: urajh rahio re baavar gaavar jiu kirakhai hariaaio pasooaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: you are entangled in them, you crazy fool, like an animal grazing in the green fields. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਾਜੈ ਸੋ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਤਸੂਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo jaanahi too(n) apune kaajai so sa(n)g na chaalai terai tasooaa ||
lines.translation: That which you believe to be of use to you, shall not go even an inch with you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਗੋ ਆਇਓ ਨਾਗ ਸਿਧਾਸੀ ਫੇਰਿ ਫਿਰਿਓ ਅਰੁ ਕਾਲਿ ਗਰਸੂਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naago aaio naag sidhaasee pher phirio ar kaal garasooaa ||1||
lines.translation: Naked you came, and naked you shall depart. You shall go round and round the cycle of birth and death, and you shall be food for Death. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਰੇ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕੀ ਲੀਲਾ ਰਾਚਿ ਮਾਚਿ ਤਿਨਹੂੰ ਲਉ ਹਸੂਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: pekh pekh re kasu(n)bh kee leelaa raach maach tinahoo(n) lau hasooaa ||
lines.translation: Watching, watching the transitory dramas of the world, you are embroiled and enmeshed in them, and you laugh with delight.

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੀਜਤ ਡੋਰਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਅਰੁ ਰੈਨੀ ਜੀਅ ਕੋ ਕਾਜੁ ਨ ਕੀਨੋ ਕਛੂਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: chheejat dor dinas ar rainee jee ko kaaj na keeno kachhooaa ||2||
lines.translation: The string of life is wearing thin, day and night, and you have done nothing for your soul. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਤ ਕਰਤ ਇਵ ਹੀ ਬਿਰਧਾਨੋ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਉਕਤੇ ਤਨੁ ਖੀਨਸੂਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: karat karat iv hee biradhaano haario ukate tan kheenasooaa ||
lines.translation: Doing your deeds, you have grown old; your voice fails you, and your body has become weak.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਉਨਿ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਬਾਲਾ ਉਸ ਤੇ ਘਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਰੁਚ ਚਸੂਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jiu mohio un mohanee baalaa us te ghatai naahee ruch chasooaa ||3||
lines.translation: You were enticed by Maya in your youth, and your attachment for it has not diminished, one little bit. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗੁ ਐਸਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ਤਉ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਤਜਿ ਗਰਬਸੂਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jag aisaa mohi gurahi dikhaaio tau saran pario taj garabasooaa ||
lines.translation: The Guru has shown me that this is the way of the world; I have abandoned the dwelling of pride, and entered Your Sanctuary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੋ ਸੰਤਿ ਬਤਾਇਓ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੂਆ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੨੭॥
lines.transliteration: maarag prabh ko sa(n)t bataaio driRee naanak daas bhagat har jasooaa ||4||6||127||
lines.translation: The Saint has shown me the Path of God; slave Nanak has implanted devotional worship and the Praise of the Lord. ||4||6||127||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ₄ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee₄ mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tujh bin kavan hamaaraa ||
lines.translation: Except for You, who is mine?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere preetam praan adhaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: O my Beloved, You are the Support of the breath of life. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਸਜਨ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar kee bidh tum hee jaanee tum hee sajan suhele ||
lines.translation: You alone know the condition of my inner being. You are my Beautiful Friend.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਪਾਏ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਹ ਅਤੋਲੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sarab sukhaa mai tujh te paae mere thaakur agah atole ||1||
lines.translation: I receive all comforts from You, O my Unfathomable and Immeasurable Lord and Master. ||1||
